title: Attended Barista Hours and Billed Rates, Office Pantry & Beverage Program
content:
Attended barista hours are part of some Office Pantry & Beverage Program tiers and not of others, and every tier carries a billed rate for an additional barista hour.

| Tier | Attended barista hours included each week | Billed rate for each additional barista hour (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 0.0 | 32.00 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 0.0 | 34.00 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 0.0 | 36.00 |
| Barista Bar Program | 20.0 | 38.50 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 35.0 | 41.00 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 60.0 | 39.00 |

The weekly hours figure is the number of attended barista hours included each week, stated to one decimal place. The rate is the billed rate, in United States dollars, for each additional barista hour on that tier.

Three tiers carry no attended barista hours at all, each showing 0.0 included hours, and still carry a printed rate for an additional hour. The rate does not rise with every step up the range: Campus Pantry Network Program is rated at 39.00 for an additional hour against the 41.00 rated on Full Hospitality Pantry Program, while carrying the largest weekly allocation at 60.0 hours.
